correctness.rationale: Exact Hermite–Laguerre eigenvalue formula gives (1); a uniform fixed-order Poisson/Stirling expansion and the Charlier generating function give (2)–(5). The Hermite differential equation proves the explicit polynomial identity (6), algebraically cross-checked for orders 0–12. At each nondegenerate positive peak, 2H′=xH cancels the second term and produces F1/F0=-x/6, while discrete rounding affects the relative peak only at O(R^-1). For k=2 the exact leading envelope has global peaks ±sqrt(5), of height 8exp(-5/2)>1/2 at zero; polynomial-Gaussian Poisson tail estimates exclude remote maximizers. Four radii and independent high-precision integrals corroborate but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The universal all-fixed-Hermite-order signed shoulder coefficient resolves leading-order degeneracy for each positive nondegenerate annular concentration peak. The exact cancellation is structural, not an arbitrary numerical slice; for the physically standard second excited Hermite window it determines a concrete global optimal mode and the asymptotically sharp nonzero spectral competition gap. This is new mathematical information beyond the known first-Hermite case and the generic Hermite–Laguerre diagonalization.
